evaluation_config.selection: maximum mean canonical baseline validation selected-checkpoint reward across five seeds; constant wins exact tie
evaluation_config.beta_selection: compare the single 0.05 candidate under constant and decay on validation; retain the better regularized treatment even if BC0 wins, and report that failure
evaluation_config.training: canonical PPO, frozen 64x64 Tanh BC actor and paired random critic; canonical Markov train population
evaluation_config.bc_data: frozen D train observations and F0 hard labels only; uniform natural visits, independent local RNG, batch 128
evaluation_config.decay: beta0 * max(0, 1 - num_timesteps / total_timesteps), at each PPO update
evaluation_config.long_run: selected regularized schedule only; no further selection or tuning
evaluation_config.optional_q_pretraining: omitted to keep the final contrast identifiable
evaluation_config.constrained: existing portfolio benchmark retained separately because portfolio-level allocation is not a single-customer policy

ope.truth: independent final nominal test cohort; finite Monte Carlo error reported

hypotheses.H1: BCInit preserves more state dependence than canonical PPO.
hypotheses.H2: Regularization reduces teacher boundary erosion relative to BCInit.
hypotheses.H3: Better preservation need not improve economic value.
hypotheses.H4: Effects differ or weaken under severe stress.
hypotheses.H5: ID advantage can coexist with greater OOD degradation.
hypotheses.H6: ID-only gains do not establish robust superiority.

evaluation_config.inference: paired seed/customer bootstrap, 95 percent marginal intervals conditional on the simulator; other contrasts exploratory
evaluation_config.counterfactual: fresh test states, uniform natural visits; independent 32 selection and 32 evaluation draws; shared frozen canonical seed101 continuation; H12; first-action deviation only
